My notebook is full of scratches and doodles, quick recipe ideas and flavor-pairing ideas out the yang. With a massive collection of flavors (a contested necessity, according to my better half) and more ideas than time to work on them, I find myself with a fairly large amount of recipes in my "Lab" folder - mixes that are either untested ideas, or things that have been made and altered, waiting for v2 to roll out into the air.

So! What're you all "working on?" What's your current project?

Currently, I'm gearing up for a pretty big test-batch to work on ratios on my latest endeavor - tobacco-apple-pie-ala-mode. Y'see, a long time ago, I bought a lot of vendor juice looking for the best of the best. Indigo Vapor had just released their NET line (which has seemed to either disappeared altogether, or been integrated into the normal menu without much mention) and among them, my favorite "Didn't think it'd be as good as it is" juice: Nanna's Blend. It's got apple pie with a swish of vanilla creaminess and a little bit of bakery-style flakiness that leant to pie instead of straight apple - all of it over an earthy, musky (cigar?) tobacco. Never woulda thought it would be as good as it was, and I bought many, many bottles of it.

Flash forward, I'm mucking around with this tobacco blend and that, figured I'd toss a little Apple in one of them - and it convinced me that this was in reach. Not even looking to clone it, per se, just make something that would get me to have that satisfied "mmm" again.

So I'll be working on that soon, maybe even write up a big ol' run down of all the different things I tried, what worked and what didn't.

How bout you?
